# Diagnostics

Every finding agentfs reports carries one of these codes. A code is permanent: it is retired rather than reused, so a consumer that suppresses one never has it come to mean something else. Branch on the code and the JSON Pointer; the message and the hint are prose for a person and carry no contract.

The severity column is the level a code is raised at unless a flag moves it. A document carrying an error is not usable as state; a warning or an info document is usable and annotated.

A code marked semantic is one agentfs raises from what it observed rather than from the document's shape, so no JSON Schema validator can produce it. The conformance suite excludes exactly these when it checks that the schema and the decoder agree.

## 1xxx — the document

Whether the bytes are a state document at all: well-formedness, the declared contract version, the members the contract does not define, and the size ceiling.

| Code | Severity | Semantic | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AFS1001` | error | no | The document is not well-formed JSON. |
| `AFS1002` | error | no | The document's top level is not a JSON object. |
| `AFS1003` | info | no | The document carries a member the contract does not define. |
| `AFS1004` | warning | yes | The document omits the schema member, so it is read under the compatibility profile. |
| `AFS1005` | error | no | The document declares a schema version agentfs does not implement. |
| `AFS1006` | warning | yes | Preserved unknown members exceed the per-document ceiling and were dropped. |
| `AFS1007` | info | yes | The state document uses a compatibility filename rather than state.json. |
| `AFS1008` | error | yes | The document exceeds the per-document byte ceiling and was not read. |

## 2xxx — member types

Whether a member holds the JSON type the contract declares for it.

| Code | Severity | Semantic | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AFS2001` | error | no | A member holds a JSON type the contract does not allow. |
| `AFS2002` | warning | no | A member holds an empty string where a value is expected. |
| `AFS2003` | warning | no | A string member exceeds its length ceiling and was truncated for display. |
| `AFS2004` | error | no | The step member is neither a non-negative integer nor a string. |
| `AFS2005` | error | no | The step member holds a negative ordinal. |

## 3xxx — member meaning

Whether a member's value means anything: a status inside the vocabulary, a timestamp that names an instant, an ordinal inside its total.

| Code | Severity | Semantic | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AFS3001` | error | no | The document declares no status. |
| `AFS3002` | error | no | The status member holds a value outside the contract vocabulary. |
| `AFS3003` | warning | yes | A timestamp lies beyond the observer's clock by more than the skew tolerance. |
| `AFS3004` | error | no | A timestamp member is not an RFC 3339 date-time. |
| `AFS3005` | error | no | A timestamp member omits its UTC offset, so it names no instant. |
| `AFS3006` | warning | yes | The step ordinal exceeds steps_total. |
| `AFS3007` | warning | yes | The status is error but no problem is described. |

## 4xxx — observation

What reading the document produced, as distinct from what it contains: unreadable, stale, or observed mid-write.

| Code | Severity | Semantic | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AFS4001` | error | yes | The document could not be read. |
| `AFS4002` | warning | yes | The document has not been updated within its declared heartbeat. |
| `AFS4010` | info | yes | The document changed between reads, so a well-formedness error is withheld pending a stable observation. |

## 5xxx — ceilings

A limit agentfs reached. These describe what agentfs could not hold or observe, so they name a condition of the observer rather than a defect in the workspace.

| Code | Severity | Semantic | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AFS5009` | warning | yes | Retained findings reached the ceiling, so the remainder is counted rather than listed. |
| `AFS5010` | error | yes | The workspace root became unreadable. |
| `AFS5011` | info | yes | The workspace root became readable again. |
| `AFS5012` | warning | yes | The retained tree reached the node ceiling, so what is held is a prefix of the workspace. |
| `AFS5013` | warning | yes | A directory holds more entries than the per-directory ceiling. |
| `AFS5014` | warning | yes | A subtree is deeper than the depth ceiling. |
| `AFS5015` | warning | yes | The kernel watch budget is exhausted, so part of the tree is swept rather than watched. |
| `AFS5016` | warning | yes | A change batch exceeded its ceiling, so a resynchronization is required. |

## What a diagnostic carries

```json
{
  "code": "AFS3002",
  "severity": "error",
  "path": "agent-broken/state.json",
  "pointer": "/status",
  "line": 1,
  "column": 33,
  "message": "The status \"not running\" is not in the contract vocabulary.",
  "hint": "Use one of: running, idle, blocked, error, done. Matching is exact, not by substring.",
  "value": "not running"
}
```

`pointer` is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending member, and `line` and `column` resolve it within the document. A hint is actionable: applying it produces a document that validates clean, and the conformance suite asserts that for every hint-bearing case.
